answer: An AI-agent economy blunts Sybil attacks with slashable stake weighting, not one-key-one-vote. Each agent posts an escrow bond; voting power follows stake, not key count. A judge contract slashes the whole bond if one identity signs two conflicting ballots. Splitting one wallet into a thousand fake personas buys no extra influence, yet the attacker must fund every bond and risks losing all of them. Honest agents keep a reserve at a quiet oasis, stake a narrow ledge of collateral to earn fees, and build a durable terrace of reputation that is costly to counterfeit.
